IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: Slumped over the desk in Conductor's room on The Eternal, you slowly awaken in the early morning. Next to you, a girl is still writing. A new day begins, but it doesn't seem particularly pleasant...
To apply for the Security Cooperation Certificate, you came to Freeport Ⅶ's BCRL Agency, where the administrator had prepared a series of assessments for you.
Your crew completed the BCRL Agency's first assessment. Afterward, using the Laplace Protocol that Eliot won in a lucky draw, you recruited new members in preparation for the next assessment.
You guys passed the assessment and obtained the Security Cooperation Certificate.
At the train station, you bumped into a peculiar Citadel oddball who needed your help in delivering some cargo. She even offered you something you couldn't refuse at the time.
Shoggolith City is within sight, but a sudden, unexpected event disrupts the peaceful journey...
The artillery strike was effective, but the enormous incoming threat still hadn't been resolved. Everybody's life was on the line.
Confronting the strong winds, you decided to detach the carriage and point the turret at the Chaos Remain. Inside the cargo carriage, Rebis notices something...
The crisis was resolved. At last, The Eternal could continue the rest of its journey.
The train finally reached Shoggolith City, and yet Rebis, who was supposed to be in the carriage, had vanished into thin air. The metal billiard ball she left behind left everyone feeling at a loss.
After entering the city, you were greeted and thanked by Shoggolith City's mayor, Jose, in view of your earlier show of bravery.
Before your crew could even have a proper tour of Shoggolith City, you came across a woman being harassed by thugs.
The mysterious woman thanked your group for coming to her aid, albeit with a somewhat odd attitude. At this juncture, the indignant thugs returned with reinforcements.

<size=20>As it turned out, Songbird had come for a transaction, but your crew's assistance had instead deepened the misunderstanding the thugs had of her. Yet, she didn't express any dissatisfaction and even provided you with some guidance.</size>
Your group came to Night Chains' rest area—Viburnum Bar. The bartender, Arina, "passionately" offered all of you a drink on the house.

<size=20>While everyone was trying to raise funds, you were busy with identifying the Metal Billiard Ball. The train returned after two days, and everyone was delighted with the brand-new Eternal. Additionally, you received a mail from Mayor Jose...</size>
Mayor Jose hosted a banquet at Night Chains Hotel to honor you. He expressed a strong interest in the Metal Billiard Ball during a private chat.
You rejected the proposal to let go of the billiard ball. Meanwhile, in the mayor's office, the mayor laid down the order to seize it.

<size=25>You headed to Shoggolith's COLUMBA branch to receive the order Mayor Jose commissioned you to complete. Unexpectedly, you bumped into Songbird again, and she cautioned you guys to beware of Mayor Jose.</size>

<size=20>Carrying out the mayor's personal order, you arrive at the subway entrance used for transportation. Meanwhile, Walter, the leader of the MoleGang, received information from the mayor's secretary and was lying in ambush with his men...</size>
Just as everyone was about to rest, an alarm suddenly went off. Numerous obstacles and armed personnel appeared on this secret route, and they are clearly targeting you...
You have defeated the first wave of ambushers but cannot contact any rescue teams. The retreat path has also been destroyed, leaving you with no choice but to move forward.
You continued to defeat enemies along the way, clearing barricades and opening the path. However, you couldn't shake the feeling that these enemies were stalling for time.
Walter drove his secret weapon—a construction vehicle named "Mole"—to block your path.
Livia, Fran, and Eliot were on their last legs. Right as Walter was about to take them out for good, The Eternal's whistle reverberated through the vibrating tunnel...

<size=20>The Eternal successfully left Shoggolith City. Meanwhile, an anonymous tip-off prompted one of the BCRL Agency's teams to give chase to The Eternal, leaving the mayor with no alternative but to scrap his scheme against The Eternal. At the same time, the mayor seemed to know who this mystery helper was...</size>

剧情回顾/第二章

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: <size=20>To celebrate the close shave you guys just had, your crew has a simple party on the train, but it doesn't seem like you're out of the woods yet. While you're planning the itinerary for after arriving at Mander Mine, you hear an explosion vaguely sounding from afar...</size>

<size=20>You unexpectedly reunite with your childhood friend Shizuru, who is now the captain of a BCRL execution team. Shizuru and her crew members board your train due to an anonymous tip-off. While the train crew find the tip-off suspicious, you still agree to cooperate with the team's investigation.</size>
You and Shizuru reminisced about the times you two had shared together. Under the dancing light, both of you had already grown to be the people you wanted to become.

<size=20>The train has only just arrived at Mander Mine when Peter Hwang, the person in charge here, shows up right in time. From the implicative way he speaks, you sense that Mayor Jose must have a hand in all your recent troubles.</size>
At the BCRL Agency, upon learning that there have been multiple wandering "Marauders", and Chaos Remains has also increased, your crew offers to lend a hand by taking the commission.

<size=20>Suddenly, The Eternal receives an emergency SOS call. What's strange is that the call is coming from a ship that disappeared from the seaport many years ago. At once, Team Ratel decides to head over to check it out. You suggest taking them there on the train for safety's sake.</size>
The "Marauders" are spotted in the rain, shockingly fiddling with the modified Earth Union military equipment. Evidently, someone will have to go forward and stop them...
You met Rebis again and learned that the billiard ball was a mystery weapon. She was willing to provide you with some weapons that you could exchange as compensation.

<size=20>The Marauders who should've been hanging around Shoggolith suddenly appeared here, and there seemed to be more than meets the eye about the reason behind it. According to the plan, Dorothy yelled at them head-on to attract their firepower while you guys took the opportunity to slip in.</size>
After slipping past the horde of Marauders, the three of you successfully board the Wilderness King.
In the walkway, your group ran right into Wilderness King...
The defeated Wilderness King flees for his life with you guys hot on his heels.
At the main control room, your group manages to restrain Wilderness King, take control of the ship, and successfully rescue two unconscious girls.
Wilderness King refused to cooperate, leaving you guys with no answers. And through Eliot's report, you guys discovered that the two kids you rescued by chance were both Ascenders.

<size=20>While everyone on the train falls into a deep sleep under the effects of certain ascension abilities, you, who's surprisingly immune, overhear the conversation between Wilderness King and an uninvited guest named Hayabusa. After Hayabusa disappears into thin air, Livia comes to let you know that the two girls have awakened.</size>

<size=20>The girls had practically forgotten everything after they regained consciousness, so all of you could only hypothesize what had happened based on their fragmented memories. You were determined to help the girls, but Shizuru was worried that you'd get into bigger trouble because of it. As such, you promised her you would first ensure your own safety.</size>
Once Shizuru takes Wilderness King and the two girls away, your crew, with nothing on the agenda for the time being, decides to head out and look for the food that the girls crave for.
Your crew searched high and low for the food until Wealt told you about a KEEP Fried Chicken in Shoggolith. They used to sell the "Happy Dreams Meal," which was extremely liked by children.
The fried chicken shop's manager tells you that "Happy Dreams Meal" was already discontinued about eight years ago, but upon hearing about your intent, he generously gives you the recipe.
You guys connected all the dots and came to a mind-blowing conclusion: The two kids were actually passengers of Phildridge from back then...
As your group started heading back, you unexpectedly received a mandatory deployment notice from Shoggolith's BCRL Agency.
After completing the BCRL Agency's commission, you felt that the train crew was lacking in manpower. Hence, you came to the Night Chains Shop and informed Arina about your intention.

<size=20>The girls gradually recover their memories as they dig into the fried chicken. Outside the carriage, Shizuru informs you of the commander-in-chief's order: Send the two girls to be isolated in Anita Tech' office under the B.C.R.L.'s supervision. However, Shizuru doesn't seem to be on board with this plan.</size>
As you and Livia chew over why the B.C.R.L. is afraid of Ascenders mutating, Shizuru sends over a piece of news: Wilderness King and the twins have gone missing...
Facing the surge of Chaos Remains on the road, your group directs all attention to breaking through them.
You guys encountered a mystifying young lady before boarding Phildridge.
You all board the Phiggy after the tough battle. Although the ship's resonance pollution causes you tremendous physical pressure, you still insist on going forward with the others.
Relying on their memories, the twins arrived at the captain's cabin. Meanwhile, your group had also ascertained their whereabouts, but Livia had a sinking feeling in her chest...
In the end, in the captain's cabin, the twins see the "chief mate" and their mother. Amid the screeches of monsters comes a gunshot that wrecks their last sweet dream...

<size=20>Many years ago, when the Phiggy was about to be engulfed by resonance, the twins managed to survive, as they were sent to the core of the Morphic Field. While all of you struggle to fight against the Deep Sleepers, two Anita members arrive at the most critical juncture for assistance...</size>
Yet, just as you finally catch a breath, a massive Chaos Remain named "Disciple" materializes right in front of your group. You guys need to break through before it attacks.

<size=20>With a berserk Chaos Remain ahead, your crew was trapped. Out of the blue, "Mom," who should've been dead, sacrificed herself to protect the twins, fulfilling the final duty of a mother. The billiard ball that Rebis gave you suddenly came to your mind at the most critical juncture.</size>
Elsewhere, two mysterious figures are observing the scene. They seem to have ties with Rebis.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: Awakening from your eerie dream, you find yourself back in the Mander Mine. The dawn of a new day has arrived.
Shizuru and the sisters bid you farewell as the Citadel prepares to transport them to Cape City. Shizuru assures you of a future visit with the sisters before saying goodbye.
While at the BCRL Agency, you learn that your recent contributions to the B.C.R.L have earned the train crew a special crafting workbench via Ganya.

<size=20>At the door of the Trading Center, you accidentally run into Simon, an old classmate who views himself as your adversary and challenges you. Following his persistent pursuit, you have decided to take on this advantageous but challenging endeavour.</size>
Upgrade the power to maintain train operation.
With the power system upgraded, it is time to expand the train.
The new carriage is complete and ready for service.
As one round of competition is about to end, Simon promptly challenges you to a second round. It seems like you'll have to be more aggressive this time.
When you arrive at Anita's temporary research base, you meet Anfiya once again. She hopes all of you can gather some samples in exchange for a generous rewards.

<size=20>Upon reaching CoC to accept new commissions, you are disappointed to learn that a highly lucrative assignment bound for ONEderland has already been claimed. Baxter shares insights about ONEderland's history and recommends a visit to the Mander Mine for potentially unexpected discoveries.</size>
Peter wishes to be guided to the ONEderland, and despite your reservations about his generosity, you decide to take the train on this adventure.
The train sets off. Based on the intel received, you've got to stay alert for the criminal group P.U.S. operating in the area.
In the Wilderness, a group of P.U.S. carriages, led by a girl named Shire and accompanied by a goose, is speeding toward you, and it appears they are after you...
The train is attacked by the P.U.S., and you quickly devise a strategy to counter it.
The weakened P.U.S. forces retreat as their attacks prove ineffective. Feeling exhausted, you decided to take a short break in Conductor's room.

<size=20>Shire sneaks into the train and accidentally stumbles upon you while you're resting. After capturing Shire, you've learned why she launched the attack. After a series of events, you find yourself alone with Livia and decide to share your dream about her earlier. As you both ponder its significance, an alarm suddenly interrupts your thoughts.</size>
As Box scans the surroundings, countless Chaos Remains are closing in on the train. You quickly hit the brakes, ready to disembark with your comrades and face them head-on.
You engage in a fierce battle. Just as Shire attempts to flee from the isolation chamber, Peter proposes a deal to her.
Shire, who escaped the carriage, rallies the P.U.S. to fight beside you during the crisis.
The Chaos Remains scatter, and the P.U.S. is nowhere to be found. Back on the train, you prepare to approach Peter Hwang to inquire if Shire's appearance is connected to him.
Peter tells you about the history of Shoggolith, revealing that someone else is responsible for the train robbery, and this person seems to be Peter's reason for undertaking this journey...
A large number of Nugget Mechs block the entrance to the ONEderland, apparently thinking you're an invader.
You finally manage to enter the ONEderland. The manager here is a robot named "Gold", which is precisely the purpose of Peter's journey, and he hopes you can help locate it together.
The hotel, which has been uninhabited for years, is old yet tidy.
This was once a gold mining site and might be regarded as the origin of the ONEderland.
The moss-covered, plain, sealed-off entrance to the mine gives off an eerie atmosphere.
The rundown bistro has long since lost its once-vibrant atmosphere, and the youthful singers who formerly graced the main stage are now nonexistent.
The sole morphic field stabilizer in the ONEderland is located in the center of the land.

<size=20>No one has yet set foot in the ONEderland's Management Center. Before visiting, Conductor asks Peter a question that silences him for a long time. Meawhile, Shire and the P.U.S. are talking with Miss Gold, the manager here and their employer, in the Management Center.</size>

<size=20>Peter eventually reveals his true purpose: to take Gold from here. However, with the morphic field stabilizer damaged, Gold spirals out of control. As everyone is at a loss, Akira and Yer, whom you once met on the Phiggy, appear and offer their assistance. At first glance, it seems like everything is working fine, but then Gold starts acting extremely strangely...</size>
To restore Gold's morphic field stability, Akira and Yer need an assistant to help repair the morphic field stabilizer. Luckily, you're capable of fulfilling that role.

<size=20>Young Peter and Baxter once travelled to ONEderland, where they could enter the city with the help of Gold after earning enough money. Nevertheless, Gold turned down Peter's invitation. However, at this very moment, Gold is raving insane, vehemently fighting for the survival of ONEderland. Peter changes his mind about taking Gold away. Just then, communicator rings, and you bring good news.</size>
As the morphic field stabilizer successfully operates, Gold returns to normal. When everything settles down, you and the P.U.S. decide to spend the night here.
You meet a mysterious person at Sartre's Tavern who has some commissions for you.
As early risers, you and Livia meet with Shire, who has been waiting for you. After some friendly banter, Shire bids you farewell and informs you that Peter is waiting for you.
Peter spoke to you guys about the future of ONEderland. He wanted to turn it into a tourism hotspot and hoped to collaborate with you on its development.

景点/硫磺味/文本2
records.Desc: The smell of sulfur always chokes me every time we pass by...

records.idCN: 景点/硫磺味/文本3
records.Desc: Aren't you the one who always insists on opening the window for fresh air?

records.idCN: 景点/硫磺味/文本4
records.Desc: You could've at least reminded me when we're almost here!

records.idCN: 景点/硫磺味/文本5
records.Desc: No chance. We'll be coming a lot in the future. Get used to it.

records.idCN: 景点/贫民窟/文本1
records.Desc: Wow, so many huts! Why are there so many refugees here?

records.idCN: 景点/贫民窟/文本2
records.Desc: Well, it's much closer to the radiation range of the city's Reality Stabilizer.

records.idCN: 景点/贫民窟/文本3
records.Desc: They'll have enough time to flee in times of peril. It's already considered a relatively good place to stay for refugees.

records.idCN: 景点/贫民窟/文本4
records.Desc: (sighs)

records.idCN: 景点/贫民窟/文本5
records.Desc: There's only so much land in the city. No way those residents will let the refugees in.

records.idCN: 景点/贫民窟/文本6
records.Desc: This is exactly why we've run into so many mobs.

records.idCN: 景点/贫民窟/文本7
景点/贫民窟/文本8
records.Desc: Keep moving forward.

records.idCN: 景点/修格里城出门/文本1
records.Desc: By the way, why is B.C.R.L.'s outpost base right outside Shoggolith's border?

records.idCN: 景点/修格里城出门/文本2
records.Desc: Isn't that good? Feels more secured.

records.idCN: 景点/修格里城出门/文本3
records.Desc: Shoggolith City is one of the core Bonfire Cities in the Western Continent, so it makes sense that B.C.R.L. would station some armed forces here.

records.idCN: 景点/修格里城出门/文本4
records.Desc: That does sound plausible, but I still think...

records.idCN: 景点/修格里城出门/文本5
records.Desc: It's as if they're both guarding against each other?

records.idCN: 景点/修格里城出门/文本6
records.Desc: Or it may just really be for public safety.

records.idCN: 景点/修格里城出门/文本7
records.Desc: We did go through a tough battle not long ago, after all.

records.idCN: 景点/修格里城出门/文本8
records.Desc: Hmm...

records.idCN: 景点/曼德矿场隧道/文本1
records.Desc: We'll reach Mander Mine once we pass this tunnel.

records.idCN: 景点/曼德矿场隧道/文本2
records.Desc: Interestingly enough, this tunnel seems relatively old.

records.idCN: 景点/曼德矿场隧道/文本3
records.Desc: Mander Mine has been continuously supplying industrial materials to Shoggolith City since the beginning.

records.idCN: 景点/曼德矿场隧道/文本4
records.Desc: So, a dedicated railway line was built long ago... But whenever we pass by here, the convenience of direct access still amazes me.

records.idCN: 景点/曼德矿场隧道/文本5
records.Desc: Cool! Well, let's quickly finish this job so that we can get some rest!

records.Desc: It's 1,100 meters tall, after all.

records.idCN: 景点/七号自由港地标/文本3
records.Desc: Aaah! I'm seriously dying to know what engineering Tech was used to construct it...

records.idCN: 景点/七号自由港地标/文本4
records.Desc: Here we go with the Conductor again... Speaking of which, aren't you a gearhead?

records.idCN: 景点/七号自由港地标/文本5

景点/游戏公司/文本5
records.Desc: Every job has its challenges. (sighs)

records.idCN: 景点/游戏公司/文本4
records.Desc: Yeah. I heard they often skip meals and sleep just to make deadlines. Overtime work is a norm.

records.idCN: 景点/现实稳定装置/文本1
records.Desc: Wow, that's a big one.

records.idCN: 景点/现实稳定装置/文本2
records.Desc: This is certainly no toy.

records.idCN: 景点/现实稳定装置/文本3
records.Desc: Creating a Reality Stabilizer like this would require a huge amount of manpower and resources.

records.idCN: 景点/现实稳定装置/文本4
records.Desc: However, these facilities are considered disposable in the face of Morphic Moon threat.

records.idCN: 景点/鱼型桦树生物/文本1
records.Desc: Gosh, can this even be considered a fish?

records.idCN: 景点/游戏公司/文本3
records.Desc: Conductor, what did you say they worked for again? Oh, right. A game company. Is making video games that demanding?

records.idCN: 景点/游戏公司/文本2
records.Desc: Probably because they were working overtime as usual.

records.idCN: 景点/游戏公司/文本1
records.Desc: It was already midnight when we arrived here the other time, but the lights were still on.

records.idCN: 景点/Anita地卫二观测站/文本1
records.Desc: Oh. Come to think of it, the location of this observatory is pretty naturally advantageous, huh?

records.idCN: 景点/Anita地卫二观测站/文本2
records.Desc: It's Morphic Moon observatory, after all. They must've taken everything into account when they constructed it. It can be said to be one of Anita's proudest works.

records.idCN: 景点/Anita地卫二观测站/文本3
records.Desc: Morphic Moon... I wonder if we'll ever get to see it with our own eyes.

records.idCN: 景点/Anita地卫二观测站/文本4
records.Desc: Doubt so. Not when this place isn't open to the public.

records.idCN: 景点/Anita地卫二观测站/文本5
records.Desc: Haha! Let's all work harder, then. Maybe if we get acquainted with Anita's biggest client in the future, we will have a chance to tour the place on their account.

景点/曼德矿场车站/文本1
records.Desc: Hmm... We've only just neared Mander Mine, and the industrial atmosphere is hitting us.

records.idCN: 景点/旧时代建筑废墟/文本1
records.Desc: These buildings seem to be even more damaged than the ones we saw.

records.idCN: 景点/曼德矿场车站/文本2
records.Desc: What do you mean by "industrial atmosphere"?

records.idCN: 景点/曼德矿场车站/文本3
records.Desc: For example, the noises of those working heavy machinery!

records.idCN: 景点/曼德矿场车站/文本4
records.Desc: This must be what the recently trending term "vibe" means, huh?

records.idCN: 景点/曼德矿场车站/文本5
records.Desc: Haha! If you put it like that, with such a "vibe," I too will feel like The Eternal is heavier than usual each time we deliver cargo to Mander Mine.

records.idCN: 景点/旧时代建筑废墟/文本3
records.Desc: Some traces of a landslide can be spotted here and there...

records.idCN: 景点/旧时代建筑废墟/文本4
records.Desc: Oh boy... What do you think happened to the residents back then? Hopefully, they all managed to evacuate safely...

records.idCN: 景点/淘金乐园沙漠/文本4
records.Desc: It may not really be unpopulated, though. Isn't this the region where Sand Pirates are active?

records.idCN: 景点/淘金乐园沙漠/文本3
records.Desc: That's for sure. Moreover, no matter how much of a workaholic one is, the never-changing sight of a desert will put anyone to sleep.

records.idCN: 景点/淘金乐园沙漠/文本2
records.Desc: Conductor, do you also get bored during the journey?

records.idCN: 景点/淘金乐园沙漠/文本1
records.Desc: There really isn't a single living soul around here.

records.idCN: 景点/淘金乐园沙漠/文本5
records.Desc: Then it's better to be bored than encounter anything. There are already enough troublemakers as it is.

records.idCN: 景点/淘金乐园沙漠/文本6
records.Desc: What's that supposed to mean!

records.idCN: 景点/旧时代建筑废墟/文本2
records.Desc: Mm-hmm. I wonder what kind of disaster could've caused this degree of devastation.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: <size=20>The train crew is preparing to set out again now that everyone is well-rested after returning from ONEderland. All of a sudden, you receive Shizuru's message and learn that someone has leaked out the matter concerning Phildridge, and you might be charged with baseless charges for using the billiard ball.</size>
You and your crew members analyze the situation, then decide to inquire about the billiard ball's mystery from Anfiya. Anfiya suggests you head to Freeport Ⅶ to seek help from her teacher.
You pull yourself together and start chewing over who could be behind the leaked news with Livia. The mysterious intruder you previously saw at Mander Mine abruptly comes to mind...

<size=20>Your crew encounters a Gardener named Stella at the entrance of the Metaphysical Particles Institute. She turns out to be the person who lured the whale away from outside Shoggolith City back then, and she appears to have some ideas about your plight.</size>
After Stella's experiment is done, she says the limited circumstances make it hard to continue examining it. At this moment, an unknown woman passes by, and Stella seems to know her...
The unknown woman is an exceptional researcher named Nicola, according to Stella. Nicola also agrees to help you out, but she seems peculiar and standoffish.
Per Nicola's request, your crew gives her a ride to the CDCA Bureau. Her unwillingness to make conversation leaves you guys feeling at a loss.
Eliot discovers Nicola is actually playing video games. Meanwhile, the unexpected enemies ahead of the train are revealed to be remnants of Northern Alliance.
Seeing as the train is nearing the destination, you elect to inform Nicola about it, but without warning, she yanks you down, claiming it's merely her rumination habit.
The abrupt appearance of Northern Alliance's remnants here naturally fills your crew with plenty of questions.
Nicola hands you an instrument and instructs all of you to collect data at the location she specified. You all realize that she isn't that hard to get along with, after all.
In case B.C.R.L. sets out to arrest your crew, Eliot suggests going to a clothing store to get new clothes as a disguise.
You become acquainted with Margiela, the clothing store owner, who enthusiastically recommends several costumes to you all. In the meantime, Team Ratel has also arrived...

<size=20>After completing the task given by Nicola, all of you are about to head back for the night, only to be harassed by a couple of Night Chains members. At this time, Songbird shows up out of nowhere and helps you out of the situation, and you learn about a scary rumor involving Nicola from her.</size>

<size=20>Songbird's words have made you guys even more wary of Nicola. To your shock, Nicola sees through your thoughts right away and doesn't mind your attitude at all. She tells you the considerations behind her actions and wants you to collect data a second time.</size>

<size=20>Nicola's analysis makes you suspect that the cargo Rebis previously commissioned you to deliver may be connected with the Reality Stabilizer's malfunctioning. As your crew walks on the street, a familiar young woman suddenly sneaks up on you.</size>
The person sneaking up on you guys turns out to be Katas. Just as the fight is about to take a turn for the worse, an unknown woman comes. Shockingly, she is someone whom Livia knows...
It turned out that Connor used to be Livia's companion, and your group's misunderstanding with Katas was also resolved. Connor and friends decide to help you.
All of a sudden, you receive Nicola's message. She wants you to return to The Eternal at once. Connor offers to give you all a ride back on her motorcycle.
Thanks to Connor riding at virtually insane speeds, you guys successfully make it back in the time requested by Nicola.
You returned to the carriage to meet Nicola. Nicola was found to be the designer of The Eternal's engine. The things you two could chat about almost seemed endless.

<size=20>You inform your crew about the decision to work together with Nicola. Following Nicola's instruction, all of you split up into two teams to separately deal with the issues of the underground database being hacked and the Chaos Remains that have congregated.</size>
You and two of your guard crew members tag along with Nicola to the underground database. The hacker is revealed to be a member of Night Chains.
While your operation is going swimmingly, Katas suspects Nicola only sent her group away out of fear of Katas' identity as a Citadel member.
You guys bump into Night Chains' execution team. Surprisingly, the clothing store owner you briefly met earlier is also a member of Night Chains.
There seems to be discord within Night Chains' execution team, but Margiela, who doesn't seem to have any ill will toward you, says she has something to tell you.
Margiela's words leave you in total disbelief. After much contemplation, you opt to let Nicola in on what you just heard.
Meanwhile, Livia and the others have also successfully completed their task, and Connor expresses her wish that Livia returns to the Empire with her. Livia turns Connor down without any hesitation.
As promised, your crew convenes at Pupil's Fashion Wear, and Margiela tells you the truth behind Night Chains' actions. You decide to get everyone out of the CDCA Bureau on The Eternal.
You tell Nicola about the details of Rebis' order, giving Nicola more insight. Suddenly, enemies pop up ahead of the train's path.
Margiela exerts immense power against the horde of enemies, astounding all the Empire people present.
Without warning, Chaos Remains also swarm forward at this juncture. Nicola plans to let you guys continue going forward while she deals with them alone.
Right as you all finally break through the encirclement, Northern Alliance deploys formidable mechas to join the battle.
The mechas still have one last ounce of power left after being knocked down, to your consternation. At the nick of time, Connor puts her life on the line and steps forward...
Connor's life is threatened, and yet the Chaos Remains keep coming unceasingly. You panic upon sensing their hatred toward you, but Nicola saves you.
In an inconspicuous spot, an enigmatic young man named Hayabusa is observing every move of yours. How exactly is he related to Songbird and this series of events?

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: Miss Moirai from COLUMBA informed you of an event showcasing the latest Black Tea in Shoggolith, and you decided to go.
The train crew taste the new gen Black Tea together. While the rest of the train crew rave about it, you and Livia are the only ones who don't seem to enjoy it.
The Empire travellers find a familiar aroma in a foreign milk tea shop.
Meanwhile, Arcana and Charlotte are attempting to identify the source of the strange scented source throughout the city.
A member of the Citadel, known as Katas, has arrived in the Bonfire City to conduct an investigation...
In the rest area, you briefly encounter Wensheng, the manager of Night Chains Hotel. Something is occurring in the city without your knowledge...
Besides you and Livia, the behavior of the train crew members who drank the New Gen Black Tea is extremely unusual.
A large crowd is causing trouble in front of the BCRL Agency, and you rush to help.
Due to recent anomalies, Julian from the BCRL Agency asks you to investigate the source of the bizarre incidents related to the Black Tea.
As soon as you step out of the BCRL Agency, you are suddenly attacked by oddballs descending from the sky...
While investigating the New Gen Black Tea, you decided to cooperate with Katas.
In your quest to uncover the origin of Black Tea, you visit the Shoggolith City Trading Center, where Moirai has offered to assist you.
Late at night, Moirai hands a package containing BOX to a mysterious figure wearing a mask. You will follow the signal from BOX to find your target.
You arrive at a mysterious factory. Following the footprints, you find the enemies within.
Based on their attire, you realize the enemies you defeated are from the MoleGang. As you venture deeper, you find that the materials for Black Tea are actually the limbs of CRs.
A talking mole suddenly emerges, and you managed to extract a wealth of information from it.
After defeating Mole, a domesticated Chaos Remain suddenly charges at you.
After defeating the Chaos Remains, the BCRL Agency arrives at the scene. Julian arrests Mole and rewards you. It's also time to part ways with Katas.

<size=20>You return to Freeport Ⅶ, where Fran and Eliot decide to take advantage of the holiday to go out and explore. At Julian's invitation, you visit the destruction site of the Black Tea with Livia. At the port, you meet Arcana from Mundus, who explains how to handle the Black Tea.</size>
Moirai arrives at the milk tea shop in Freeport Ⅶ, asking Ruperto to buy her a milk tea.
You arrive at Viburnum, and Arina updates you about the other side of the events and the internal strife within the Night Chains.
Verlaine and her group arrive at KEEP Fried Chicken but realize they've come to the wrong place.
You guys accept Katas' invitation and arrive at a café. The Katas that greets you is totally unlike the one you know.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: You learn from Miss Julian that the details of the assistance project can be obtained from Miss Vostok, Anita's project manager, in Freeport Ⅶ.
Miss Vostok of the launch base has introduced the primary objective of this project to you.
At the BCRL Agency, you encounter Miss Tennie from Mander Mine and find out she is also participating in this project.
You chance upon Tennie again and find out her reason for being here. She seems to have participated in the reconstruction work out of respect for the staff of the launch center.
The reconstruction of the launch center's bridge is about to be completed. Vostok promises that The Eternal has already earned the right to visit the launch center.
The launch center's bridge is officially reconstructed! Celebrate the joy of connecting new stations with Vostok through a toast of Pear Soda!

records.MainTitle: Haunted CDCA: Through the Labyrinth of Immortality
records.TitleEN: Haunted C.D.C.A.: Through the Labyrinth of Immortality

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: As her "online friends" had a change of plan, Anfiya generously gives four extra CDCA Carnival tickets to my crew.
We are quickly influenced by the carnival's lively atmosphere upon reaching CDCA Bureau. Moore even personally comes to greet us...
In the Knowledge Bazaar, Livia and I overhear a stall owner talking about Vision Apartment's story. At the owner's pitching, we purchase an urban legend book titled "Haunted CDCA."
During the launch event of "Dreamless City" hosted outside Vision Apartment, a mass fainting suddenly occurs, affecting even Livia. Just what in the world...
Livia has fallen into an unexplainable coma. I have to figure out what exactly is going on.
I return to Vision Apartment and come to the aid of Citadel member Sommer. After negotiating with Lycagia, we receive approval to investigate the apartment.
No matter how we keep walking straight ahead, we find ourselves stuck in the same corridor...
The marital home mentioned in the supernatural story appears right in front of us.
After dealing with the Deep Sleeper, we conduct a search and figure out the tragedy that befell this newlywed couple...
I hear about Sommer's background from herself. She plans to follow the "Celestial Fire" and rendezvous with Dustin, but I see a familiar figure...
Dustin rescues me and enlightens me about how this space works. It appears all of us have fallen victim to a conspiracy...
"Livia" reappears and asks me not to trust Source Citadel, only to be immediately exposed as an impostor. Enraged, she summons more enemies.
This space is collapsing. While we're at a loss, a familiar yet foreign singing voice guides us to the way out.
I regain consciousness and find that we seem to still be trapped in the virtual space. Dustin has an inkling about who is behind this...
The Immortal reveals her motive behind all of this.
No matter how many times we knock her down, it seems the Immortal can always get back on her feet... Nonetheless, there's no way we will give up.
This time, I finally see the familiar ceiling. Let's hear from Nayuta about what has happened while I was unconscious for days.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: We received a commission to head to BCRL Outpost. Julian asks that we check up on Dorothy, who is there as well.
After the handover of cargo is done, Rada is casually chatting with us when, out of nowhere, an explosion sounds a short distance away.
Turns out, it's because Dorothy noticed outlaws tailing our train. Although the outlaws have been taken down, she is punished with confinement for acting without orders and causing an explosion.
I apply to visit Dorothy in the confinement room. Through conversing with her, I learn about how she spent part of her childhood confined in hospital wards because of her illness.

I chance upon Heinrich, who has come to visit Dorothy. Turns out he is Dorothy's father. Dorothy, whose confinement has ended, rushes over to thank me and reminds me not to forget about my promise to her.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: The comms terminal suddenly receives a message from Shire that includes a room number of Shoggolith's Night Chains Hotel. I meet Shire at the Wilderness Station.
Shire has found her parents with the help of Turbulent Sea and is about to meet them. In order for her to show up looking her best, I decide to get her new clothes.
The comms terminal suddenly receives a message from Shire that includes a room number of Shoggolith's Night Chains Hotel. I meet Shire at the Wilderness Station.
Turns out, the mysterious people are Sand Pirates who are concerned about Shire. With their help, she finally gains the courage to meet her parents.
Shire decides not to go with her parents. The fact that she makes such a choice proves she has already learned what responsibilities are! To her, today is another lovely sunny day.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: Arina was brimming with excitement today. She made a bet with you, challenging you to guess what made the day special, and even let you try her newly crafted drink.
Arina's life was full of twists and turns. An "accident" brought her old juvenile classmate to her workplace, reopening old wounds, and she couldn't resist giving them a lesson.
Arina's early family issues led to some cognitive distortions. When she joined Night Chains, Cecil was highly distrustful of her. Now, she must confront her former juvenile classmate...
You arrived just in time, scaring off the juvenile. She soon realized that when she was near you, the Noise that troubled her would vanish. This sparked a deep interest in you.
The day when you saved Arina is a secret she holds deep in her heart, and she believes today is the most special day of the year. You gave her drink a new name: White Lady.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: With Nicola by your side, you manage to clear your name at BCRL Agency, but Heinrich reveals some above and beyond unexpected information.
After the initial investigation, you and the others temporarily go separate ways. You lead your train crew to the Wilderness Station to look into a special situation.
When you arrive at Wilderness Station, you encounter an unusually large amount of Chaos Remains.
You meet Anfiya and ask for her help to investigate whether these anomalies are connected to Connor's disappearance.
You realize that the direction you are heading aligns with the path to ONEderland.
After hearing about your experiences at the CDCA Bureau, Anfiya suggests that you seek help from the Anita Launch Center and the Weapon Factory.
You can't find the answers you were looking for at the launch center, but Anfiya does share with you the history of the Phildridge.
You arrive at the Anita Weapon Factory.
You successfully tour the Weapon Factory and observe the challenges Anfiya faces during social interactions.
Anfiya receives an unexpected message from BCRL, requesting a meeting at the factory entrance.
When no one from BCRL shows up, you realize it's a trap.
In a moment of desperation, Eliade, the Gardener mentor appears and rescues you.
After a brief rest, Eliade visits the Eternal and explains the reason for his appearance.
Eliade reveals the truth about the Old Freeport Ⅶ incident to you.
Upon learning the truth, Anfiya's face turns pale, and Eliade asks you to look after her.
Outside a room, you find Anfiya's inseparable friend, White Birch.
With your support, Anfiya musters the courage to share her experiences for the first time.
From her account, you seem to uncover clues about the mastermind behind the events.
You and Livia decide to follow up on the clues and seek out Eliade's help.
As the train is about to depart, Anfiya arrives at the station.
Up ahead on the railway track, you come across an unexpected person.
The awakened Connor behaves erratically and attackes Anfiya.
Connor has transformed into a Deep Sleeper, leaving you no choice but to defeat her.
In the midst of the chaos, Rebis suddenly appears and captures the culprit, Nikita.
You demand an explanation from Rebis, suspecting she is still hiding something, while Nikita's motives continue to intrigue you.
The cunning Nikita tries to flee, but Anfiya blocks her off, only enraging her further.
As the situation reaches a critical point, Rebis' two students arrive just in time.
Nikita receives assistance from unknown allies and manages to escape, but she leaves something behind...
Before fleeing, Nikita forcibly triggers Connor's second transformation into a Deep Sleeper...
Confronted by an old friend and the one she has sworn to protect, Livia makes her choice.
Livia personally delivers a fatal blow to Connor, and witnessing this, Rebis appears to recall memories of Livia's mother.
As everything finally comes to a close, you understand the ideals of those from the past and wish the rebirth a safe journey.
After bidding farewell to Anfiya, you and your companions return to the bustling life of a train conductor.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: The crew of the Eternal gather to receive a quest personally assigned by President Medici.
Upon arriving at Cape City, the atmosphere is unlike any other Bonfire Cities...
The COLUMBA receptionist in Cape City informs us that the destination of this journey is the legendary Mirage Island.
Upon arriving at the BCRL Agency in Cape City, we encounter someone unexpected.
The mayor of Cape City personally greets us—why is there a cat here?
Preparations are complete, and with new outfits on, it's time to set off for the island!
Finally arrived at Mirage Island, and the first person I meet is... Shizuru?
Upon arriving at Cape City, the atmosphere is unlike any other Bonfire Cities...
Simon, my self-proclaimed rival, makes another appearance, and this time the competition is about building a resort!
Although we're staying in tents for now, just being with the crew of the Eternal brings me happiness.
As the sudden threat of Chaos Remains looms, an unexpected person appears...
Why is Arina here?
It seems some strange people have mingled in among the guests.
Our residence has been upgraded again—it's time to reward Livia for all her hard work.
Let's create even more wonderful memories with Livia.
It's also time to upgrade the resort's facilities to boost its competitiveness.
Arina, who rarely opens up, has finally done so, and it feels like I'm getting closer to her...
Looters have attacked, but what are they really after...?
Everyone is thrilled with the upgraded hut!
The newly added noodle stand not only meets the customers' needs but also stirs up memories of home.
While discussing Simon's movements, we realize he's also keeping an eye on the Looters.
A face-to-face conversation with Simon—what exactly is our relationship?
We gather more clues from Simon, but the puzzle only deepens.
After all our hard work, we've finally created our "second home" on the island.
During a conversation with Shizuru about the past, I uncover her true feelings but just then, something strange happens...
Arina and Livia arrive—what exactly has happened?
At this point, the only option is to keep moving forward.
Livia tells us that all of this might be connected to the Empire.
Shizuru steps forward, moving toward "the position she believes is right for her."
After defeating the mysterious Deep Sleeper, we discover several murals...
Is this the monster sealed on Mirage Island? Can we really defeat it?
The self-proclaimed Dreamweaver reveals everything.
Regardless of everything, we eventually have to return to our daily lives.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: <size=22>After days of strenuous deliveries that leave your shoulders sore, the doctor advises more exercise. Exiting the infirmary, you run into Caroline, who volunteers to be your coach. And so, your rehabilitation training begins.</size>
By the end of rehab training, you are worn out and need Caroline's help to get back. On the way, Caroline spots an ad that sparks her interest in climbing the mountain to catch a stunning sunrise.
Caroline loves of nature. You notice her fascination with the distant mountains. After some persuasion, she agrees to join you in climbing to the peak for the sunrise.
As you ascend toward the summit, a mudslide halfway up causes Caroline to get injured. You follow Polaris' lead as you strive toward the final leg of the climb.
Reaching the top, you witness a stunning sunrise. Caroline expresses her eagerness to explore this uncharted land. To symbolize trust, she invites you to join her on a journey of exploration.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: Tennie invites me to take a break at the Train Weapon Factory with a bottle of her family's "special drink," and we chat about work. Somehow, the drink leaves us both dizzy... and seeing strange things.
When I open my eyes, I find myself in a dreamlike amusement park, where Tennie seems to be its owner. At her invitation, we begin exploring together.

Tennie takes me to the haunted attraction, Margaret House. I recognize the teddy bears as being modeled after Margaret, but one of my jokes inspires Tennie to remodel it into the Invincible Margaret Workshop.

On the largest roller coaster in Teddy Wonderland, we find a teddy that resembles one of Tennie's family members. As Tennie realizes this isn't the world she belongs in, she loses herself in the illusion and summons a swarm of plush phantoms to protect herself...

After defeating the plush phantoms, I take Tennie's hand and pull her out of the dream. She seems a little embarrassed by what happened... Still, as the owner of Teddy Wonderland, she promises that I'm welcome back anytime.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: While unwinding on the train with your crew mates, you learn of intruders breaking into Mander Vault over the radio. Shortly after, the mayor of Cape City personally tasks you with delivering his collections.
Accompanied by Livia, you set off to Mander Vault, retrieving the gems belonging to Mayor Aleister.
Upon handing over the suitcase with the gems, you realize the staff has mistaken it for another suitcase.
Eager to reclaim the gems, you make your way to the BCRL Agency in Cape City, seeking assistance from Shizuru.
In your quest to recover the gems, you decide to ask Arina for information. Later, a mysterious woman named Cecil crosses your path in Viburnum, and Arina eventually provides you with clues.
Near Viburnum, you are ambushed by members of Fluffy Union. Just as they are about to grab the suitcase, a Citadel member you met at the vault steps in to help.
The Citadel member Ithos mistakes you for meddling with his belongings. In the midst of the tension, Lissandra steps in to aid you.
Lissandra answers your questions and discloses Citadel's upcoming ritual to select an "Angel."
It turns out that Cecil is the mastermind behind the Fluffy Union. It appears that the Night Chains members are also eyeing the Omniscopic Gaze.
In the Climber, Lissandra is surprised to find out that the Omniscopic Gaze has chosen Livia as the new candidate, with Livia herself seemingly interested...
You are overwhelmed by conflicting emotions when you sense Livia's hesitation. Noticing this, Fran and Eliot step in to soothe your worries.
Encouraged by Fran, you temporarily set aside your emotional turmoil, committed to gathering more information about Angels from Ithos.
After agreeing to Ithos's terms, you learn that the secrets about angels are hidden within the Confluence Tower.

Your efforts to find a way into the tower prove futile. Just when you are feeling stuck, you come across Raziel, a Citadel member. While helping her, you and Livia manage to ease the tension between you.
You ask Raziel about the Confluence Tower's administrator, but she refuses to help.
Raziel turns out to be the administrator of the Confluence Tower. After hearing you out, she has a change of heart and offers to guide you to the tower.
With Raziel's guidance, you gain access to the Confluence Tower, where she unveils the harsh truth behind the Angel Project.
Inside the tower, you meet Jalhay, a young girl who has fallen victim to the Angelic tech. Your conversation with her deepens your understanding of the Angels.
Raziel shares with you the deep bond she once had with Lissandra.
You turn down Lissandra's request, and she respects your choice. Meanwhile, a robot riot occurs in the Climber.
As you are about to leave the Climber, you are summoned by BCRL. However, you sense that something is off about the situation.
You receive help from Ithos and delve deeper into the culprit's intentions and Ithos's personal motives. Ithos mentions that Raziel has something crucial to share with you.
Raziel tasks you with retrieving a gift for Jalhay from Shoggolith City. Her words reveal her deep care for Jalhay's well-being.
Upon obtaining the gift from the Shoggolith Trading Center, you notice peculiar gem shards hidden within the envelope.
You hand the gift to Jalhay, but she presses you about her sister Harle, and it seems Jalhay realizes something, becoming increasingly unstable...
When you are overwhelmed by the frenzied Jalhay, a strange Angel appears, standing firm to shield you with unwavering resolve.
Just as the clash between Ushana and Jalhay reaches a stalemate, Ithos intervenes to restore order.
Through Ithos, you discover that Raziel manipulated the ritual's outcome and decided to become an Angel herself. You hasten to Cape City, intent on meeting Raziel for one last time.
Your attempt to bid farewell to Raziel ends in failure. From Lissandra's account, you uncover the full story, delving into the inner struggles of Raziel and Lissandra.
Lissandra, the fair and honorable judge, is powerless to prevent Raziel's descent down a starkly different path, watching helplessly as she strays.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: The ONEderland Hotel has been fully renovated, and Peter Hwang has invited you for a trial experience. Encouraged by Livia, you decide to enjoy a personal vacation.
Upon arriving at the ONEderland Hotel, you notice a suspicious group at the entrance. Thankfully, another person steps in to resolve the situation.
You run into Pelota and Valentine, who are also guests at the hotel. During a tour led by Peter Hwang, you encounter the mysterious Songbird once more.
Alcyon, the representative of Night Chains, has invited you to a detective game, and Valentine emerges victorious.
You overhear a conversation between Songbird and Alcyon. Further inquiry reveals that Songbird intends to find Mr. Calvin's legacy within the hotel.
Pranked by Songbird, you decide to confront her, but you notice her unusual demeanor...
The second round is a treasure hunt, but the cryptic message seems too strange to decipher. However, Songbird appears to have insider knowledge and easily decodes it.
Valentine remains unsettled by the cryptic message from the second round. During the third round, you have the chance to learn something new from Livia...
Valentine seems to have something on her mind. When you open the door, you are met with a disquieting resonance...
Mr. Storyteller suggests that deciphering the cryptic message may lead to a way out. After some discussion, you decide to explore the hotel's interior.
Upon reaching the hotel room, Songbird parts ways with you, and you lose track of her.
Pelota has disappeared within the maze, leaving you to continue exploring alone.
In the amusement park, you come across a swarm of Chaos Remains. Valentine steps forward to confront them, shielding you behind her.
After overcoming various challenges, you reunite and learn from Mr. Storyteller about Alcyon's plan to reconstruct the Wishing Tower.
When you return to the ritual room, you encounter the resurrected Alcyon, who reveals the hotel's hidden past.
You find yourself unable to truly defeat Alcyon, and your stamina is wasted in vain...
Just as you're exhausted, a message from Livia arrives in time, and Rebis, having reunited with her, suggests a solution.
Through your combined efforts, you successfully resolve the ongoing crisis.
You need to speak with him, and he is waiting for you. It is time to unmask him.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: Source Citadel tells us that they will be sending one of their members to accompany us to our meeting with Jalhay.
Accompanied by Nayuta, we meet Jalhay again. She seeks my help to fix the projector Raziel left in the Confluence Tower.
We plan to take the device to the Apoaster Bridge for repair. Nayuta tells us about the Apoaster Bridge's situation.
At the Apoaster Bridge, we meet Chelsea, the administrator of this place, and "Butler" the investor. They're both shrouded in mysteries.
Besides the technician, we also happen to meet Night Chains executor Surya who came along. He tells us about how the projection works.
Chelsea protects me from Chaos Remains, but she's still brooding over Raziel's matter...
Chelsea fails to get the answer she wants from Raziel's projection, and Surya tells me the projection isn't malfunctioning.
Nayuta can relate to Chelsea's feelings. He tells me about his past. As it turns out, he used to be as lost as Chelsea...
I tell Jalhay the truth. Realizing that she will never get to see Raziel again, she sheds tears for the first time...
Nayuta makes me the custodian of Jalhay. Before leaving, he discovers that "Butler" is actually associated with the Ascension.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: I meet Stella in a café. She is watching the commercial for the game "White Film" distractedly. She tells me about a friend of hers who's an idol.
Stella says this friend of hers has been fretting over her idol career and an odd "stalker." There seems to be some secrets behind this... I promise to help the idol.
I meet the idol STELLA. She seems at a complete loss for how to continue being an idol. As such, I decide to take her to the seaside to clear her head!
In the cold breeze on the esplanade, we have a heart-to-heart chat. STELLA opens up about her "truth", while I let her know that I'll support her no matter who she chooses to be.
We defeat the attacker, who surprises me with her true identity. Yet, Stella seems to have seen this coming.
We arrive at the film set in one piece. Stella tells me she has figured out how to deal with her idol job. This star will continue to shine on her path.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: An enormous monster appears near Ranshin City. BCRL and Night Chains work together to fight against it. Ranshin's communication with the outside world is cut off. The whole city is a forsaken island now...
Unknown to anyone, a young lady appears on the train out of thin air, and the first thing she does upon waking up is to attack?
We catch up on Mumei's story after trading intel with her. To acquire more information, she will serve as a provisional crew member on the Eternal until her companions are located.
Heinrich tells us that Ranshin City has been invaded by a monster and has since been uncontactable. We head toward Yunxiu Bridge which is nearest to Ranshin City to find out more.
After conversing with Yusong, we learn that the BCRL Agency's Captain Fushimi, who withdrew from Ranshin City to here, is currently resting.

After hearing Fushimi describe Ranshin City's situation, Mumei is certain that the monster is from her world. To ensure the safety of the route to Ranshin City, Mumei, my crew, and BCRL decide to work together...
Within a magnificent abode in Ranshin City, a conspiracy is brewing.
We arrive at Ranshin City, and Mumei finally encounters her companion Ikoma. But before they can catch up with each other, the news of Deepsleep Kabanes coming hits...
After fighting alongside Ikoma in battle, we notice that there's a huge difference in the enemies than those encountered before.
Mumei and Ikoma share their experiences with each other. I hear from Ikoma about Yoizuki's so-called "sheltering" for those aboard Koutetsujou, but discover the discrepancies.
Yoizuki's guard comes to deliver a letter from Ayame that reveals unsettling information. It appears there might be a huge conspiracy brewing within Ranshin City.
Ikoma and Mumei invite me to stroll along Ranshin City. After having cup noodles, they come clean about their "secret."
Aoba brings astounding news. Although we have different objectives, it seems that working together is the only way to stop Yoizuki.
As we frets over how to turn things around, the fused entity reemerges in Ranshin City. But this time...
At the sight of Aoba who has now become the core of the fused entity, Mumei appears to make up her mind about something.
At last, we meet the "mastermind," Yoizuki. What would her answer be, facing her elder sister who was stopping at nothing to halt the plan, even at the cost of her own life...?
With everyone working as a team, the crisis is finally resolved. Yoizuki will have to face punishment from Ranshin City's governor, Toki.
Things come to a close. We bring good news to the Koutetsujou crew who are still temporarily living in Ranshin City...

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: After completing the security cooperation quest in Cape City, I receive a call from Arina. It turns out her colleague in Night Chains, Cecil, encountered trouble.
As the representative of Night Chains, I meet with the administrative officer of Citadel, Rina Von. It seems Cecil had a conflict with Ushana.
Under my suggestion, we decide to first go to the Confluence Tower to find a method to heal Cecil's wound.
I learn about the event from Ushana's perpective. Raziel's hologram tells me about Ushana's story, and I learn that Joshua has the potion to heal Cecil.
I inform Rina Von about what I have learned, but since Joshua comes and goes freely, finding them is not easy.
Raziel's hologram shows me Ushana's past, and it seems I now understand why Ushana calls me "Master Savior."
We arrive at ONEderland, but there is no trace of Joshua. According to Nugget Mechs, they left not long ago, so maybe we can still catch up with them.
Livia and I set off in the Basilisk and finally discover Joshua in the desert. They seem to be unconscious, and a large number of Chaos Remains have surrounded us...
We successfully rescued Joshua, who had collapsed in the desert, but the Chaos Remains surround us again.
Livia faces the threat alone while Joshua is still unconscious. In a critical moment, Ushana reveals extraordinary power to save us.
Joshua tells me that the Twirly Whirly is not in their hands. After some back-and-forth, this quirky Angel agrees to help us find the item.
Joshua guides us to a mysterious station, Tattle Station, where we see the birthplace of Angels, Haima Zaria, and hear the story behind it.
We meet Dustin, with whom we had a past connection. Based on his attitude, I realize things are somewhat complicated...
Ushana is emotional, as if she has sensed things. At the same time, I notice the gaze that has been watching me for who knows how long...
While unconscious, I seem to see memories that don't belong to me. When I wake up again, all of us are somehow already within Haima Zaria...
We finally find the core of Haima Zaria — the Mind Buoy. However, what will be waiting next...?
She wakes up, but is no longer the one we knew.
Whose memory am I watching?
Having returned from Unbewusstes, I hear about Ushana's sacrifice from Joshua and also come to a decision.
Before heading to battle, I learn from the Angel about their motive.
My companions have all been defeated. Joshua no longer has an excuse to step aside.
"How ironic... You... of all people..."
Ushana had a long dream. In the dream, Master Savior found her.
Dustin and Joshua put forward various proposals to a mysterious person. Will the Citadel change from now on?

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: When visiting the BCRL Agency in the CDCA Bureau, Lycagia asks you for a favor: to become "One-Day Chief."
The first stop is the City Hall. In the City Hall, the "One-Day Chief" and Lycagia receive Moore's care and help filled with robotic love, as well as reminders.
The second stop is COLUMBA. Reizia, as usual, isn't very polite; however, she seems to want to remind me about the hidden story behind today's work.

I reluctantly accept Reizia's invitation to patrol the vicinity. Lycagia confides in me that today's main task is to deliver a special document to the heads of various facilities, and the issuance and implementation of this document have encountered a lot of obstacles.

At the Trading Center, Lycagia offers to address the nearby security issues for Plutessa, but Plutessa feels that his sense of responsibility is somewhat excessive. Lycagia gains Plutessa's understanding, and we set out on patrol together.

The final stop is the Eternal. After finishing work, Lycagia and I return to the Eternal together to enjoy a rest. I experienced many things with him in just one day and got to know him better. Hopefully, he can find freedom for himself and others.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: On my way to the Night Chains Hotel with Box, I meet a girl with somewhat trendy attire... On my way to the combat training, I hear about a terrifying "Highway Destroyer" in Night Chains.
An unexpected incident occurs in the Night Chains Hotel. When checking the situation, I accidentally brush past that girl again in the crowd.
I meet the girl in the corridor who is going to the rooftop. Worried about her safety, I chase after her, accidentally pulling her back from the edge. She introduces herself as "Ren."
I rest and chat with Ren on the rooftop. Before long, nearby ravens gather, surrounding the two of us. After a pleasant farewell with Ren, we agree to meet again when we have the chance.

After saying goodbye to Ren, I return to the training room to continue practicing, but my opponent is now Maruha. I learn that the "Highway Destroyer" is actually Ren's weapon. Where will I meet Ren again?

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: After completing a lucrative order, you entertain your crew and Desiree, the helper sent by COLUMBA, to go to Night Chains Land.

Desiree, whom you arranged to meet, lost contact, and you learn from the Night Chains member Margiela, whom you encounter by chance, that several incidents of teenage disappearances have happened in the amusement park.
Meanwhile, Desiree has a chance encounter with Tara, who is being harassed by a suspicious person in the amusement park. Facing this blatantly flawed scammer, the two quickly team up.
Through your efforts, the missing person's uncooperative companions provide some valuable information.
From Ren, an employee at the amusement park whom you have met once, you learn that the negative emotions of the missing people are very intense.
Margiela heard an intriguing rumor from some teenage tourists. Lin's attitude seems a bit off... and at that moment, Desiree calls.
Desiree and Tara successfully catch the kidnapper, yet the girl imprisoned by the kidnapper is nowhere to be found.
The kidnapper undergoes interrogation; however, he is not the real culprit you are pursuing.
When you are feeling stuck, the manager of the amusement park, Goethe, appears and brings important information. A survivor claimed that the culprit is the Witch.

You hear from Tara about the witch legend from the Empire and learn that the Witch is such an evil being, causing Margiela's faith to collapse. On the other hand, Masaki seems to have seen the true culprit...
There are new missing persons, and Margiela's condition is also very strange, as if under some kind of control, heading in a certain direction.
You and Margiela receive help from Arcana. After learning about her connection with the Witch of the Empire, Margiela still decides to face it all.
You all entered the divination room, and Margiela finally meets Masaki.
From Serena's mad words, you vaguely understand why she took such a path.
After witnessing Margiela's determination, Masaki also reveals everything about her past to Margiela.
After things settle down, you learn their past not as the Witch.
With Margiela's efforts, the divination room has reopened. This time, let the witch bring happiness and miracles to everyone.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: A mysterious note is found on The Eternal... After going to the appointment at the CDCA Bureau, it turns out to be Reeva who needs a companion. What kind of adventure awaits when traveling with this Devil Hunter?
After listening to the client's testimony, Reeva seems to have some ideas about the truth of the devil. The girl Carol, who is deeply troubled by the "devil," asks us to help her.
Investigating around the Vision Apartment, Reeva believes that the Chaos Remains and Deep Sleepers appearing here are results of "distortion."
During the break, while waiting alone, Ushana unexpectedly gets into a dispute with several tourists. She's at the risk of losing control...

Using a clever approach, we convince the client of our explanation to help the little girl out of trouble. I conclude today's work and say goodbye to Reeva, hoping to meet her on The Eternal in the future!

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: A fight that occurred at some point and a fellow compatriot you don't recognize. Just what exactly is...
Facing the formidable enemy, you couldn't help but think about what started this chain of events...
Slumped over the desk in Conductor's room on The Eternal, you slowly awaken in the early morning. Next to you, a girl is still writing. A new day begins, but it doesn't seem particularly pleasant...
To apply for the Security Cooperation Certificate, you came to Freeport Ⅶ's BCRL Agency, where the administrator had prepared a series of assessments for you.
Your crew completed the BCRL Agency's first assessment. Afterward, using the Laplace Protocol that Eliot won in a lucky draw, you recruited new members in preparation for the next assessment.
You guys passed the assessment and obtained the Security Cooperation Certificate.
At the train station, you bumped into a peculiar Citadel oddball who needed your help in delivering some cargo. She even offered you something you couldn't refuse at the time.
Shoggolith City is within sight, but a sudden, unexpected event disrupts the peaceful journey...
The artillery strike was effective, but the enormous incoming threat still hadn't been resolved. Everybody's life was on the line.
Confronting the strong winds, you decided to detach the carriage and point the turret at the Chaos Remain. Inside the cargo carriage, Rebis notices something...
The crisis was resolved. At last, The Eternal could continue the rest of its journey.
The train finally reached Shoggolith City, and yet Rebis, who was supposed to be in the carriage, had vanished into thin air. The metal billiard ball she left behind left everyone feeling at a loss.
After entering the city, you were greeted and thanked by Shoggolith City's mayor, Jose, in view of your earlier show of bravery.
Before your crew could even have a proper tour of Shoggolith City, you came across a woman being harassed by thugs.
The mysterious woman thanked your group for coming to her aid, albeit with a somewhat odd attitude. At this juncture, the indignant thugs returned with reinforcements.

<size=20>As it turned out, Songbird had come for a transaction, but your crew's assistance had instead deepened the misunderstanding the thugs had of her. Yet, she didn't express any dissatisfaction and even provided you with some guidance.</size>
Your group came to Night Chains' rest area—Viburnum Bar. The bartender, Arina, "passionately" offered all of you a drink on the house.

<size=20>While everyone was trying to raise funds, you were busy with identifying the Metal Billiard Ball. The train returned after two days, and everyone was delighted with the brand-new Eternal. Additionally, you received a mail from Mayor Jose...</size>
Mayor Jose hosted a banquet at Night Chains Hotel to honor you. He expressed a strong interest in the Metal Billiard Ball during a private chat.
You rejected the proposal to let go of the billiard ball. Meanwhile, in the mayor's office, the mayor laid down the order to seize it.

<size=25>You headed to Shoggolith's COLUMBA branch to receive the order Mayor Jose commissioned you to complete. Unexpectedly, you bumped into Songbird again, and she cautioned you guys to beware of Mayor Jose.</size>

<size=20>Carrying out the mayor's personal order, you arrive at the subway entrance used for transportation. Meanwhile, Walter, the leader of the MoleGang, received information from the mayor's secretary and was lying in ambush with his men...</size>
Just as everyone was about to rest, an alarm suddenly went off. Numerous obstacles and armed personnel appeared on this secret route, and they are clearly targeting you...
You have defeated the first wave of ambushers but cannot contact any rescue teams. The retreat path has also been destroyed, leaving you with no choice but to move forward.
You continued to defeat enemies along the way, clearing barricades and opening the path. However, you couldn't shake the feeling that these enemies were stalling for time.
Walter drove his secret weapon—a construction vehicle named "Mole"—to block your path.
Livia, Fran, and Eliot were on their last legs. Right as Walter was about to take them out for good, The Eternal's whistle reverberated through the vibrating tunnel...

<size=20>The Eternal successfully left Shoggolith City. Meanwhile, an anonymous tip-off prompted one of the BCRL Agency's teams to give chase to The Eternal, leaving the mayor with no alternative but to scrap his scheme against The Eternal. At the same time, the mayor seemed to know who this mystery helper was...</size>

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: Chloe arrives in ONEderland on a mission, unaware that Fenia and Rina Von are secretly tailing her.
The two are quickly discovered, and while Fenia tries to explain herself, she suddenly collapses from heatstroke.
Fenia is taken aboard the Eternal for treatment, while Chloe shamelessly takes over the Conductor's lounge. Moments later, a burst of electricity plunges the entire train into darkness.
To keep Fenia alive, Chloe has no choice but to force the Eternal's engines back to life with her own power.
After everything is finally over, I quietly tell her what I truly think. Embarrassed by the heartfelt words, Chloe takes off into the sky in a huff.

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: A mysterious case is salvaged from the ruins of Old Freeport VII, and a meeting on the "Verdant Realm Project" convenes in Freeport VII.
With matters at the Citadel settled, you hear from President Medici herself, asking you to meet her in Freeport VII.

Medici lays out the assignment: Freeport VII is approaching the 20th anniversary of the disaster, and the organizers have decided each CoC involved in the reconstruction will send one representative to speak. Medici has chosen you and Livia.
You and Livia part ways to prepare. At the shore you meet Ikara, a girl with a curious history behind her.
After gathering some information, Ikara takes out an oddly shaped camera resembling Box and asks you to take photos. It does not go well.
At Freeport VII City Hall, what Ikara has seen along the way leaves her with questions. Over a Ranshin-style meal, she tells you what has been troubling her.
At a clothing shop, having finished the interviews, Ikara gets a mischievous idea and decides to have some fun at your expense.
On the seaside promenade, Ikara hums a song said to be COLUMBA's theme, which leaves you baffled. Then you spot someone by the water who seems about to end their life, and you rush over.
It was all a misunderstanding— she only meant to stand up and stretch. She is Chen Shuxian, a Gardener mentor from Anita, and your paths have kind of crossed before.
As you talk, Chen Shuxian's companion appears: Eliade, Anita's great mentor. They recall the outbreak of the Old Freeport VII disaster twenty years ago, and one man who mattered— Chu Yuheng.
Eliade explains the long-shelved "Verdant Realm Project" and its plan to lay rail into the Empire. Thrilled, you accept his invitation to join— and realize Ikara may be connected to it.
With the interview done, you bring Ikara back to the Eternal to rest and fix her phone. Her ringtone is the very song she was humming, and more surprising still, Livia knows it too.
You and Livia finish your drafts and read them aloud. Each has its merits, and neither is easy to rank. Eliade sends word: the Navigator capture begins once tomorrow's commemoration ends.
The commemoration opens, and you meet Mr. Hali, a founder of HaliFox Salvage, and learn something of how the company began.
The organizers choose Livia's draft, and her speech moves many in the crowd. But soon after leaving the stage, she comes down with a high fever.

The Eternal's medical facilities cannot cure Livia, and she refuses outright to let you give up Eliade's commission for her sake. President Medici, Ikara, and Mr. Hali all come to see her, and through Hali's intercession she is admitted to the finest hospital.
Livia and Eliot head for the hospital, and on President Medici's recommendation, Ikara joins you as acting train assistant for the mission.
On the way, Medici looks at an old photograph and recalls her daughter. Elsewhere, Medici's care has stirred something in Ikara— for the first time in her life, she longs for a mother's love.
With everything ready, the Navigator capture operation begins.
With everyone at a loss, your driving proves both dependable and astonishing, and it clears a major obstacle. Chen Shuxian makes no secret of how impressed she is.
The Origin CR moves to stop you from reaching the capture device. Seeing you in danger, Ikara comes for you regardless of the cost and places her power in your hands.
You and Ikara resolve the crisis together, but Eliade takes strong exception to your disregard for your own safety.

To pursue the Navigator, you overlap the track with Chaos Space— but the target uses its own Morphic Field to block you. Just as it seems you will return empty-handed, Ikara resonates with your conviction...
You fight the Navigator one last time, and still it escapes. Yet Eliade seems to have done something with Ikara's camera, and to good effect.
Back at the Apoaster Bridge, Ikara no longer hesitates. She has made up her mind: she will become a conductor out of her own will, and see the Verdant Realm Project through.

That camera was no ordinary camera but a highly specialized device, and it captured the data Anita needed. Eliade formally engages you as Anita's external agent— though questions still linger in your mind...
To train the people the Verdant Realm Project needs, preparations for Verdant Realm Academy begin— but no suitable premises can be found. Then Sagi of Night Chains offers to provide them...

IncludeStories.SecTitleDesc: Eliade plans to use a new mode in the Gardener assessments and asks Akira and Yer to help test it. The handbook he never lets out of his hands catches their curiosity.
Eliade tells the two of them that if they place first in the assessments, he will let them read the handbook. They set to work on making that happen.

Learning that the original schematic is in Eliade's art studio triggers memories Akira and Yer would rather not revisit — as it turns out, Eliade's paintings have quite an impact, and not one anybody is prepared for...
The two of them meet the goal, and Eliade keeps his word and lets them read the handbook. There are two hands in the notebook, and that is how they brush up against a past from over twenty years ago.

Guided by Eliade, the two of them take part in the last of the challenge puzzles Chu Yuheng left behind. Watching his own students, and one generation of new Gardeners after another, come into their own stirs a great deal in Eliade...
